metadata.title: Ganka CMS
metadata.description: Content management system of Ganka for Home.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: Access to the CMS is granted by an administrator once your email is confirmed.
signUp.successText: Open the link from the email to finish. If this address already has an account, the email says so.
signUp.devHint: Development: there is no mail provider yet, so the email is printed in the console of pnpm bdev. Open the link from it.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.description: Enter the password of your account to finish.
verifyEmail.successText: You can sign in once an administrator grants you access to the CMS.

acceptInvite.title: Accept the invitation
acceptInvite.description: Set a password for your CMS account.
acceptInvite.successText: Sign in to the CMS with your email and the new password.

errors.passwordTooShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.invalidCredentials: Wrong email or password, or this account has no access to the CMS.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

field.focalHint: Click the image to choose the part that stays in view when it is cropped.
field.altHint: Describes the image for screen readers and search engines.

errors.tooLarge: The file is too large. The limit is 10 MB.

errors.invalidFile: The file could not be read. Choose another image.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to upload images.

collections.newDescription: Fill in the Ukrainian texts at least. A new collection stays hidden from the storefront until you make it visible.
collections.editDescription: Slug {slug} · SKU prefix {sku}. Changes reach the storefront right after saving; images are saved as soon as they are uploaded.

empty.title: No collections yet
empty.description: Create the first collection with the button above.

forbidden.title: No access to collections
forbidden.description: Collections are edited by catalog managers and administrators.

form.slugHint: Part of the address: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens.
form.skuPrefixHint: Assigned automatically in creation order and never changes. The first part of product codes.
form.sortOrderHint: Smaller numbers come first in lists.
form.isActiveHint: Hidden collections are kept here but not shown to customers.
form.ukHint: Required. Also shown in English when there is no English text.
form.enHint: Optional: fill in title, short and full description, or leave all empty.
form.title: Title
form.shortDescriptionHint: Under the title on the collection page.
form.descriptionHint: A blank line starts a new paragraph.
form.metaTitleHint: For search engines. The title is used when empty.
form.metaDescriptionHint: For search engines. The short description is used when empty.
form.skuPrefixNewHint: Assigned on save: the next free number from 001 to 999.
form.inBanners: {count, plural, =0 {No home hero banner links to this collection.} one {# home hero banner links to this collection.} other {# home hero banners link to this collection.}}

delete.title: Delete “{title}”?
delete.description: The collection and its texts are deleted for good. Its images stay in the media library.

errors.invalidSlug: Use lowercase Latin letters, digits and single hyphens between them.
errors.translationIncomplete: Fill in this field or leave the whole language empty.
errors.slugTaken: Another collection already uses this slug.
errors.seasonNotFound: This season no longer exists. Choose another one.
errors.mediaNotFound: One of the images was deleted from the library. Upload it again.

errors.serverError: Something went wrong. Try again later.
errors.skuPrefixExhausted: All SKU prefixes from 001 to 999 are used. A new collection can’t get one.
errors.usedInBanners: Banners link to this collection. Change or delete them on the Banners page first.

board.hintDrag: Drag rows by the handle to change the order, then save.
board.hintFiltered: Clear the filters to change the order by dragging.
board.hintSorted: This sorting is only a view. “Use as order” turns it into the order to save.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches the filters
noMatches.description: Choose “All” in the filters to see every collection.

board.unsaved: The order has changed but is not saved yet.

errors.stale: The list changed meanwhile (a collection was added or deleted). Reload the page and try again.

a11y.instructions: To pick up a collection, press Space or Enter. Move it with the arrow keys, press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to cancel.

empty.title: No seasons yet
empty.description: Create the first season with the button above.

forbidden.title: No access to seasons
forbidden.description: Seasons are edited by catalog managers and administrators.

dialog.description: The name shows in the catalog season filter. Collections pick their season in the collection editor.

form.labelEnHint: Optional: without it the Ukrainian name is shown.
form.slugHint: The filter value in the address: lowercase Latin words joined by - or _ (new_year). It can’t be changed later.
form.slugFixed: Collections and links use it, so it can’t be changed.

delete.title: Delete the season “{title}”?
delete.description: The season and its names are deleted for good.
delete.inUseHint: Used by {count, plural, one {# collection} other {# collections}}: choose another season for them first.

banners.description: The slides of the home hero, in the order customers see them. A slide links to a collection or to any page (a promotion, the blog) and can be shown only between two dates.
banners.newDescription: A new banner goes last in the hero and stays hidden until you switch it on.
banners.collectionHidden: The collection is hidden, so the slide is not shown

empty.title: No banners yet
empty.description: Create the first slide of the home hero with the button above.

forbidden.title: No access to banners
forbidden.description: Banners are edited by content editors, catalog managers and administrators.

form.collectionHint: Without its own title the slide shows the collection name.
form.urlHint: A page of the site (/products, /info/delivery) or a full https:// address.
form.textsHintCollection: All optional: empty fields take the collection name and the default button text.
form.textsHintUrl: The Ukrainian title is required; English falls back to Ukrainian.
form.title: Title
form.subtitle: Subtitle
form.subtitleHint: The small line above the title.
form.ctaLabelHint: Empty: the default text is used.
form.isActiveHint: A hidden banner keeps its place in the order.
form.scheduleHint: Optional, Kyiv time ({zone}). Without dates there are no limits. The storefront picks changes up within a few minutes.

delete.title: Delete this banner?
delete.description: The slide is removed from the hero for good. Its image stays in the media library.

errors.titleRequired: A link banner needs a Ukrainian title.
